title: Plancherel identity on a finite vector space
statement:
Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $f,g:V\to\bbr$. Their uniform inner product satisfies the Plancherel identity
\[\mathbb{E}_{x\in V}[f(x)g(x)] = \sum_{\psi\in V^*}\widehat f(\psi)\widehat g(\psi),\]
where $V^*$ is the linear dual and each Fourier coefficient is the uniform inner product of the function with the Walsh character associated with that functional.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is an additive commutative group and an $\mathbb{F}_2$-module
